provenance: historical source-frozen 12 conversations x 4 turns; original model answers and candidate text kept author-only

method.tokenization: Unicode normalized and casefolded, terms length >=4, common stopwords omitted, stems truncated to first 6 letters
method.new: Absent from both birth user's input and contemporaneous host answer
method.unprompted: Also absent from later user input
method.two_rare_stems: Two distinct such stems, each in <=10 of the 94 candidate texts, co-occur in one later host answer
method.rare_bigram: Two adjacent filtered stems in <=3 of 94 candidate texts, absent as a pair from birth user input, birth host answer and later user input, present in later host answer

limitations: All semantic relation and useful-new-test judgments remain unassessed
Screens include generic or task-dependent word matches
Accepted/rejected groups are not randomized or independently sampled
T3 candidates have no later turns
Host responses were never exposed to the candidates during these 48 recorded turns
No actual seed memory benefit or Q2 causal effect was tested
Original candidate texts and author-only inspection queue not published in this PR
